Dear support crew,
The floor manager brought up a reminder about training days earlier today, and I wanted to pass it on

Please keep the pace steady and the tone friendly when you walk new staff through pet check-in work. The welfare coordinator is still reviewing comfort notes for each case, so stay alert for carrier fit, water access, and calm handoffs. If you spot a concern, raise it in the usual stepwise order instead of trying to solve everything at once. That keeps the desk consistent and helps us avoid mixed messages for travelers and handlers.

Please also remember that the quiet review notes belong in the same thread as the booking details, not scattered across side chats. <<FACT F027>> Keep your wording plain, keep your updates brief, and avoid piling on extra commentary that could distract the next person reading the file. <<FACT F005>> If a case needs a follow-up, flag the concern cleanly, then let the next reviewer take it from there. <<FACT F015>> The goal is simple: steady process, calm wording, and a clean handoff for every animal.

Thanks for keeping the standard high and the desk running smoothly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
